annotation.title_clean: К вопросу о формализации этики поведения коллаборативного робота
annotation.title_en: On the issue of formalization of collaborative robot ethical behavior
annotation.venue: Информационные и математические технологии в науке и управлении (Information and Mathematical Technologies in Science and Management)
annotation.summary_en: Russian journal article (Kurchatov Institute / Bauman MSTU) on mechanisms that would let a collaborative robot act as a moral agent. It argues that non-classical logics cannot formalize ethics. It proposes Bentham/Mill utilitarianism combined with hedonistic axiology and analysed with cognitive maps, and stresses the role of moral schemes in explaining behaviour.
key_provisions_or_claims: Logical schemes and non-classical logics fail to formalize moral teachings given irreducible contradictions and incompleteness
Moral schemes mainly serve to explain behaviour, not just to evaluate an action
Agent behaviour is determined by current needs and the state of its perception system
Morality rests on comparing conspecifics with the 'Self' (degree of friend vs. foe)
Moral representations justify the behaviour the agent chooses
